Home.heroSubtitle: An AI fashion visual production agent for apparel brands, e-commerce and content teams.
Home.heroDesc: Upload clothing, model, pose and background references to produce try-on shots, product sets, lookbook covers and a reusable visual workflow — all in one go.
Home.heroCapabilities: Covers virtual try-on, AI video, fusion, pose variation, product sets and lookbook covers
Home.featuresIntroTitle: The best way to generate fashion visuals with the agent

featureTitle.0: Try-on shots go from reference image into one workspace
featureTitle.1: AI video extends the story of static product images
featureTitle.2: Fusion blends multiple assets into one complete visual
featureTitle.3: Pose variation reuses your winning compositions

featureBody.0: Break clothing, model, pose and background into clear inputs, then generate deliverable try-on shots around fit, color and figure proportions.
featureBody.1: From image to video, first/last frames and motion control live in one visual workspace, so generated clothing shots flow straight into short-video assets.
featureBody.2: Freely mix clothing, reference images, models and scenes to quickly produce cohesive model shots, sets and reusable visuals.
featureBody.3: Extend one validated hero image into sitting, standing, half-body and detail angles — keeping garments consistent while filling out your ad assets.

Home.sameAgentTitle: Use the same agent across every launch
Home.sameAgentDesc: Use Pixel Diffusion across pages and environments, connected through your team's asset library.

sceneDesc.0: Preserve fit, color and detail while generating realistic model try-on shots.
sceneDesc.1: Extend generated clothing shots into lively short videos for ads and social seeding.
sceneDesc.2: Merge clothing, model, scene and reference into one cohesive visual.
sceneDesc.3: Quickly expand one outfit and model into multiple angles and poses.

testimonialQuote.0: We cut the pre-launch trial-shoot cycle from two days to half a day — and, most importantly, the garment details stay intact.
testimonialQuote.1: Different designers used to produce wildly inconsistent imagery; now, with the same model and parameters, the whole store looks unified.
testimonialQuote.2: Product sets and lookbook covers can be planned together, so ops no longer jump between a dozen tools.
testimonialQuote.3: Reusing parameters from past work is a lifesaver for topping up best-sellers — way fewer reworks.
testimonialQuote.4: Model, pose and background are clearly separated, so new teammates can get the shot right by following the flow.
testimonialQuote.5: What we love most is retrying failed tasks with the original parameters — troubleshooting is far easier now.

Home.finalCtaDesc: Hand your fashion visual production to one AI workflow — from the first reference image to a reusable launch template.
Home.footNote: An AI fashion visual production workspace for apparel brands, e-commerce and content teams.
